responsibility: This machine-description file owns NDS32 RTL patterns for doubleword scalar moves and related lowering of DImode and DFmode data. It defines expanders and insns for register, memory, and FPU transfers, uses helpers such as nds32_output_double and float load/store emitters, and contains the target-specific splits that break unsupported 64-bit loads, stores, constants, and awkward odd-register moves into paired SImode operations, distinguishing it from the main scalar move patterns in nds32.md.
